externalContract.limitation: The 180 EC comprises 60 compulsory first-year EC, 39 common second-year EC plus 21 prescribed Aardoppervlak EC, and third-year Hydrology 6, Philosophy/History of Science 6, thesis 18 and open profiling 30 EC. Open individual choices require prior board approval, at least 12 EC at level 300 and at most 6 EC at level 100; listed or university minors can be exempt from prior approval if entry requirements are met. Foreign choices follow these levels and may include at most one 6 EC master course, not reusable in a later master. Jumilla fieldwork requires 15 programmed first-year EC passed before 1 March; its report follows the fieldwork. The second-year excursion and Jura fieldwork require 54 compulsory programmed EC and the Jumilla report passed before 1 February. The Jura report follows the fieldwork and must be passed before the thesis. The thesis page also requires February registration and approved agreement forms; the Jura report page states a 1 March passing deadline. These are distinct published administrative statements, not a relaxed prerequisite. The ordinary first-year study-advice threshold is 42 EC, subject to exceptions. Dutch language testing and required remediation are integrated into Plate Tectonics without extra EC. The zero-credit year-two study/career course requires attendance, assignments, a LinkedIn profile and a networking report. Practical/workgroup attendance may apply as specified in course manuals. Optional honours and other routes are not stacked.
